output.summary: Independent review 2 of 71b4533..5002b94 and the whole 4a4aa8a..5002b94: the reviewer's verdict is Ready, with no Important findings. I1 and I2 are fixed and pinned by tests: six steps on one row (flex), and the draft and design kept as written outside the top header. The minors taken up are fixed too. Forms are identical to main for 18/18 state x viewer pairs. The browser sweep was 78/78 clean. Reverting fixes one at a time: 10 of 11 reverts fail a test. Minor 1: a real renderTeamDesign output shows 'Understanding gate (G3): pending' in the 설계 section, because the Office writes it after the Task list rather than in the header. Minor 2: no test stops item numbers widening to \d+, which matters only when a year line is directly followed by a numbered list. Minor 3: '## ' inside a code fence becomes a heading; this cannot happen today because planner fields are single-line.

evaluation.feedback: The reviewer found the change Ready. The caller chose to take up Minor 1 and Minor 2 before verify, because Minor 1 puts English kit jargon on every high-risk design that a PL approves (the U50 goal is plain Korean). Fixes: drop the Office-written '^Understanding gate (G<n>): ' line wherever it appears, as kit-role-runs does; add a test with the real renderTeamDesign and renderPlanningStory output; add a test where a year line is followed by a numbered list. Leave Minor 3: no single-line field can carry a code fence.
